messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER (sev2) -> eng-runtime: High error rate and latency for hosted inference in us-east1. Triggered by kv_cache_miss_rate > 15% and batch_queue_ms > 400ms at 1769140001 :rotating_light:
ryan: I saw the alert, grabbing logs and tracing. Any deploys in last hour?
maria: no deploys from infra; I see a push to quantization-profile service by jeff at 1759998800 but unrelated? checking selectors now.
sam: looking at request traces: noticeable pattern: sudden KV eviction storms when selector switched to aggressive int8 quant path. Cold-miss spikes, then backlog causes batch windows to enlarge.
jeff: I made a conservativeness tweak to kernel-selector config earlier today (int8 prefer). I rolled a quick change at 1759998800 but left a fallback. Rolling selector back to conservative now.
ryan: mitigation plan options: (A) rollback selector (jeff) (B) temporarily force kv cache TTL increase and pin hot prefixes (sam) (C) reduce max batching window to 30ms to protect latency SLO (maria). Recommend B + C immediately while jeff rolls back.
maria: runbook command to reduce batching window:
```
POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/runtime/regions/us-east1/config
Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN
Body: {'batch.max_delay_ms': 30, 'batch.max_tokens': 512}
```
Applying to us-east1 first.
sam: pinning hot prefixes: runbook snippet:
```
redwoodctl cache pin --region us-east1 --model=redwood-rlhf-v2 --prefix='user:' --ttl=3600
```
I'll pin top 5 prefixes.
jeff: rollback of selector started at 1769140105. deploy-bot: ROLLBACK job initiated (job id rb-9891).
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE at 1769140180, selector reverted to stable-2.0. Observability shows kernel fallback errors ceasing.
maria: after batch window change and prefix pinning, median latency dropped from 480ms to 80ms, p95 from 1.3s to 210ms. Error rate (5xx) down 87%. Pushing same changes to eu-west1 as preemptive measure.
ryan: customer impact: CS flagged two customers with realtime features degraded for ~25 minutes. Nina, can you draft outbound?
nina: on it. Drafting short note: apology, what happened (KV eviction + batching), mitigation, ETA for postmortem. Will send to affected customers by EOD.
ryan: on-call rota: sam remains primary until the end of shift, jeff is backup. I'll hand off to nina in 40 minutes for customer comms follow-up.
sam: action items for post-incident tracking (please add to JIRA):
- INVESTIGATE: quantify how selector changes impact KV eviction rhythms; reproduce with load test (owner: eng-ml / jeff) - JIRA INF-2102
- REMEDIATE: add canary perf test and preflight for quantization selector flips (owner: eng-ml) - JIRA INF-2103
- OBSERVE: expose kv_cache_eviction_rate, per-prefix hit ratios, and add alert for >10% sustained for 5m (owner: eng-platform) - JIRA INF-2104
- TUNE: document safe batch windows per model family and traffic pattern; publish guidance (owner: maria) - JIRA INF-2105
- RECOVERY: build an automated emergency disabling path for selector changes that degrade perf (owner: runtime-team) - JIRA INF-2106
Please add ETA fields and link PRs.
jeff: noted. I'll own INF-2102 + INF-2103. I estimate repro + small perf canary in 5 business days.
maria: INF-2105 assigned to me, target doc and config templates in 7 days.
nina: INF-2104 and customer comms tracked under CS-498. Draft sent to ryan for review.
ryan: scheduling postmortem review: propose Fri 11:00 PT (30m). I'll create calendar and add recording. Postmortem doc draft link: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/INF-2102-draft (please add findings).
sam: small followup: we should add quota safety so a cache storm doesn't blow up upstream DBs. Adding INF-2107 (owner: eng-infra).
nina: customer note sent to affected customers with status and next steps, copied ryan + sam.
ryan: excellent. Closing the live incident at 1769140600. We'll keep this thread for action tracking. Thanks all :thumbsup:
